scope: Rendered original GLB and skinning; game scale .84, floor 0; inferred forward translation from game speed, not physical motion capture

stanceDrift.method: Finite difference of a fixed set of foot-weighted vertices during two consecutive near-floor phases; add nominal +Z player speed. Diagnostic estimate, not live-video tracking.
